name: canon-suggestions
description: Worker and D1 database behind Canon's suggestion form

scripts.list: wrangler d1 execute canon-suggestions --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, topic, email FROM suggestions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.count: wrangler d1 execute canon-suggestions --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS suggestions FROM suggestions"
scripts.token:new: security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s canon-admin-token -U -w "$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '=+/')" && echo 'Stored in Keychain as canon-admin-token. Now run: npm run token:push'
scripts.token:push: security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s canon-admin-token -w | wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN
scripts.stats: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s canon-admin-token -w)" 'https://canon-suggestions.jatinpandey5.workers.dev/stats?days=30' | python3 -m json.tool
scripts.events: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $(security find-generic-password -a "$USER" -s canon-admin-token -w)" 'https://canon-suggestions.jatinpandey5.workers.dev/events?limit=100' | python3 -m json.tool
scripts.funnel: wrangler d1 execute canon-suggestions --remote --command "SELECT work, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN name='work_view' THEN session END) AS reached, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN name='spotlight_open' THEN session END) AS spotlit, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN name='audio_play' THEN session END) AS played, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN name='audio_complete' THEN session END) AS finished FROM events WHERE work IS NOT NULL GROUP BY work ORDER BY reached DESC"
